json.encode_value.doc: json_encode($v, $flags, $depth) of a request-model serde_json::Value (no binary strings or non-finite floats)

json.encode_throw.doc: json_encode($v, $flags | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR, $depth): the JSON or JsonException

json.decode_throw.doc: json_decode($s, $assoc, $depth, $flags | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR): the value or JsonException

json.decode_value.doc: json_decode($s, true, $depth, $flags) into the request-model serde_json::Value (php_std::json::decode_value)

deviations.php: json_decode('1e999', true) returns INF (numbers beyond the float range decode to infinite floats).
deviations.reason: php_std::json::decode_value builds serde_json::Value, which cannot hold a non-finite float; it fails with Error::Unrepresentable. php_std::json::decode (Zval) returns INF like PHP and is fuzzed with such numbers; the json.decode_value profile leaves them out.

deviations.php: Objects other than stdClass (JsonSerializable, enums, public properties), resources and recursive arrays.
deviations.reason: Not representable in Zval or serde_json::Value; the libraries only encode arrays, scalars and stdClass.
